title: AW28 Girls' Season Colour Analysis
summary: AW28 girlswear colour is projected around mulberry and antique gold with bottle green.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 kidswear fairs take place in January 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fairs, kidswear brands' long-term practices and market drivers, and will be updated as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Forecut's AW28 projection: ink, mulberry and bottle green over oat and slate, with petrol teal and vermilion as accents<sup>[1]</sup>
- Future Snoops' AW28/29 "Blocked brights": "Bold colour becomes an act of defiance, a refusal to disappear into the algorithmic mass"; blue leads, with red and purple rising, and cornflower as a new "anchor colour"<sup>[2]</sup>
- AW27 fairs put violet, plum and deep red forward as alternatives to black, and pink and mauve became gender-neutral<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** oat, petrol teal.
- **Seasonal:** bottle green, mulberry, antique gold.
- **Accent:** vermilion.

sections.heading: By product
sections.body:
- Bottle green: coats.
- Mulberry: knits.
- Vermilion: accessories.
- Oat: basics.

design_implications:
- Lab-dip key colours on each main fabric before committing.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Keep the core deep and the accents shallow until the fairs confirm them.
